placement: Tooling / Conformance (guardrail) — tools/guardrails/core-metrics.ts computes a deterministic Core complexity report (pure); scripts/check-core-budget.ts measures the repository (sources, emitted dist/, contract, package.json), compares it to architecture/core-baseline.json and fails on the hard gates and the 10% review triggers, and can recompute the #59 reference metrics at 9a835cc from Git. The baseline is guardrail-owned, so feature work cannot move it. Wired into npm test and CI. #19's payload profiles consume the same emitted-module measure rather than duplicating it. No runtime source change.
